about: Distant Horizons 3.3.2, approved by Elias on 3 October 2026 (docs/design/mod-pingpong.md#distant-horizons-310): client only, on by default in the Overworld and ignored in every other dimension. 3.3.2 rather than 3.3.3, whose new Chunky hook throws 'Chunky is not loaded' (DH issue #1329). Default Options seeds config/DistantHorizons.toml once (tools/generate_client_defaults.py), so a player's later changes survive pack updates.

qol.distanthorizons: Renders simplified far terrain (LODs) beyond the vanilla render distance in the Overworld only; on by default at a 128-chunk radius, turned down or off from its button in the video settings

pins.evidence: Official Modrinth CDN (version Ez3cx7Yd), SHA-1 d18b0829416ec6948102524b6e913e5bc73ae402 and SHA-512 from the version API matched; the official CurseForge file record lists the same name and 28,224,156 bytes. The mods.toml declares clientSideOnly=true, the project license LGPL-3.0-only (LICENSE.LESSER.txt in the jar) and one incompatibility, SSRD <=1.8.6, which the lock does not hold
